plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-9002 · 按真实行列式截断估计第三带的近对角能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-9002 · Bound near-diagonal band-three energy at an actual determinant cutoff

brief.zh: 给每个非空纤维应用行列式步长 n/g，固定一个点至多有 2⌊Hg/n⌋ 个邻点。用 2|uv|≤u²+v² 及邻接对称性保留真实平方权。取 A=⌊n^(1/3)⌋+1、B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋ 得父题的因子带。远壳和宽弧扣除另需估计。
brief.en: The determinant step on a nonempty fiber is n/g. Each point has at most 2⌊Hg/n⌋ neighbors. Apply 2|uv|≤u²+v² in both orders to retain the actual squared weights. Set A=⌊n^(1/3)⌋+1 and B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋ for band three. Far shells and wide arcs need separate estimates.
